entries.27cfffeeadf7d11e: This is a business that manufactures [[term:semiconductor|semiconductor]] integrated circuits (LSI) such as analog, logic and memory chips. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥218,390 million (up 7.1% year on year) and segment profit was ¥24,535 million. The company explains that products for body applications and xEVs grew in the automotive market, and that demand for amusement applications in the consumer equipment market and for servers in the computer & storage market recovered.
entries.2bff66e616ab5dea: This is a business that manufactures print heads and optical modules. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥31,589 million (down 3.0% year on year) and segment profit was ¥3,522 million. The company states that print heads increased for office equipment, while optical modules declined for in-vehicle LED modules.
entries.5f35a6bc3e3d6d8f: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, and includes the resistor business and others. Resistors are a product that ROHM COMPANY LIMITED has handled since its founding in 1954. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥25,903 million.

entries.cf36e120fb7d5c03: A comprehensive electronic components manufacturer headquartered in Kyoto that makes power devices, LSIs, diodes, resistors and other products in its own factories.
entries.d32fd4fc5456dd47: This is a business that manufactures transistors, diodes, power devices, light-emitting diodes and semiconductor lasers. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥205,263 million (up 9.7% year on year), but segment loss was ¥22,704 million. The company states that SiC (silicon carbide) power devices were firm for xEVs in the automotive market, and that semiconductor lasers grew for the computer & storage market.
